name: Epilepsey Warning
author: AAidalol
description: The first ever AALL level to recieve a buffdate to be listworthy and then placed after reverification. Consists of a pretty difficult ship challenge with a cool strobing effect and the Zodiac song. The pre-buff date version of this level was made back in early 2022. Also the first actually somewhat difficult ship challenge that Aida verified on her left hand.
